objective: Independently grade the supplied HCJC technical status report against the current repository, live site, and public source evidence; classify unsupported claims; and provide evidence-bound recommendations for the first agentic auditor.

skills.name: aai-cognitive-interface
skills.terminate_when: The requested report is verified and persisted, or one exact external blocker remains.
skills.why: Owns task scope, evidence labels, artifact custody, and the instruction-versus-evidence boundary.

skills.name: claim-source-auditor
skills.terminate_when: Every material factual claim has one evidence status and a source locator or stated evidence gap.
skills.why: Decomposes the supplied report into atomic claims and reconciles each to authoritative evidence.

skills.name: code-verification
skills.terminate_when: Repository scope, viable checks, failures, and residual runtime gaps are classified.
skills.why: Separates static source evidence, executable checks, and live deployment claims without modifying the project.

skills.name: research-execution-briefs
skills.terminate_when: Public deployment and repository facts are independently retrieved or explicitly inaccessible.
skills.why: Coordinates current public-source research with primary-source preference and explicit uncertainty.

skills.name: firecrawl-search
skills.terminate_when: The site evidence route returns usable content or a recorded retrieval failure.
skills.why: Provides an independent retrieval route for live-site evidence and page extraction.

skills.name: exa-search
skills.terminate_when: Relevant authoritative pages are found or the search route is exhausted.
skills.why: Provides high-recall independent discovery for public repository and deployment evidence.

skills.name: computer-use
skills.terminate_when: A bounded live-browser pass records observable page state and any access limitation.
skills.why: Checks rendered public behavior that source files and crawlers cannot establish.

skills.name: agent-churn-control
skills.terminate_when: No equivalent local action is rerun without a valid decision or typed invalidation.
skills.why: Gates duplicate retries and distinguishes accepted local evidence from pending tool attempts.

terminate_when: All material report claims are graded from current-run evidence, the report artifact is validated and persisted, and first-auditor recommendations are bounded by the evidence.
